For \(p=17\): \(17\cdot 18^2=2^2\cdot 3^4\cdot 17\), so divisor count is  
\[
(2+1)(4+1)(1+1)=30.
\]

For \(p=19\): \(p+1=20=2^2\cdot 5\), so  
\[
\tau(19\cdot 20^2)=2(2\cdot2+1)(2\cdot1+1)=2\cdot5\cdot3=30.
\]

For \(p=23\): \(p+1=24=2^3\cdot 3\), so  
\[
\tau(23\cdot 24^2)=2(2\cdot3+1)(2\cdot1+1)=2\cdot7\cdot3=42.
\]

Thus the smallest such prime is \(\boxed{23}\).
